description: Takes a plain-language question about ATI Lab (services, industries, results, pricing guides, open jobs, contact, how engagements work) or a topic its guides cover (Claude rollouts, AI agents, automation tools) and returns the best-matching atilab.io pages, each with a short answer, quoted passages and a markdown URL. Text is quoted from the site; nothing is generated. An empty list means the site has nothing on it. Same results as https://www.atilab.io/ask.

limit.description: How many results to return, 1 to 20. Defaults to 5.

question.description: The question in plain language, e.g. "Do you work with insurance brokers?"

name: atilab_ask
title: Ask atilab.io a question
